Autofill fixtures

Login patterns for testing Ludworks Browser autofill, save and update prompts. Run server.mjs and save a login for http://127.0.0.1:18120 (and http://localhost:18121 for the iframe).

  • Plain form (POST)
  • fetch() login, no form, no submit button
  • Multi-step (username, then password)
  • Shadow DOM (open shadow root)
  • Shadow DOM (nested roots, form-associated fields)
  • Cross-origin iframe login (same-origin)
  • React-like controlled inputs
  • One-time code (TOTP) step
  • One-time code in split boxes
  • Change password
  • Sign-up (password generation)
  • SPA: login form rendered late after a route change
  • Login in a modal dialog
  • Plain form in a new tab (target=_blank)
